images.title: Cylinder net: 44 cm by 10 cm
images.purpose: Shows the net of a cylinder: a rectangle as long as the circumference, with a circle on each long side.
images.composition: Plain white background with generous empty margins; the main object is large and centred and fills about 60 percent of the frame; nothing else is drawn. One net in the centre: a long rectangle with one circle touching the middle of its top edge and one touching the middle of its bottom edge.
images.exact_structure: A rectangle 44 units long and 10 units tall filled teal #0072B2. One circle of radius 7 units filled amber #E69F00 touching the midpoint of the rectangle's top edge from above, and an identical circle touching the midpoint of the bottom edge from below (whole net 44 wide, 38 tall). Labels: along the top edge of the rectangle, left of the circle, '44 cm, the circumference'; on the rectangle's left edge '10 cm'; a thin radius line in the upper circle labelled 'radius 7 cm'.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The rectangle's long side is the circumference, 2 × 22/7 × 7 = 44 cm, and its short side is the height.
images.description: Shows the net of a cylinder: a rectangle as long as the circumference, with a circle on each long side.
images.context: Concept T8.C2; one image that shows only the main idea.
images.teaching_notes: Counters the idea that the rectangle is only as wide as the diameter, 14 cm.

image_decisions.why: The size of the rectangle is the whole point and is clearest when the net is drawn to scale.
